method: Opened each generated file in Guitar Pro, used Save As, then exported native MIDI for pitch/duration checks. Read the Sound Automations dialog. Volume sweep changes only GP3 byte980 from0 through16 before native Save As. No native UI operation was simulated. Raw MIDI does not expose native sound/gain automation; exact native saved events and the sound dialog supply that evidence.

conclusions.mix_notes: All 12 occurrences retain string, fret and MIDI61. Native original and repaired MIDI note-on/off events match exactly, including velocities and durations.
conclusions.sound_timing: Public ratio0.25 writes Sound Position1; native UI tick481. Both native sound events retain their bar and order.
conclusions.legacy_controls: Tempo173, program73, volume0.56 and pan0.3125 survive native save with Linear=false. All17 volume conversions were measured independently.
conclusions.contexts: Default/flat, capo3, independent capo0/3 staves, display12, clef8vb, beat8va, harmonic5, absolute61, grace3 and sounding-offset omission tested. Harmonic MIDI84 has duration1920 at480PPQ.
limits: Sounding transposition remains a separately reported omission; target native pitch61 matches exported tuning and fret.
Native Guitar Pro rewrites clef/beat octave TransposedPitch coordinates without changing notation marks or note playback.

Pinned AlphaTab misplaces nonzero-position Sound events and ignores gain/pan automations. Its raw legacy interpolation also differs from native step events. These are reference defects, not reasons to corrupt native GPIF.
